faq.title: Your questions, answered
items: Do I need to be a company to have the app under my brand?
No. Your app carries your logo, colours and name whether you're a sole trader or a company, whatever the size of your gym.
Is the website really included?
Yes. We build you a custom website with your team, your equipment, your photos and your prices, plus online sign-up and payment. Domain and hosting are included in your fee too.
What does the visit include?
We come to your gym, measure the space, study the floor plan and advise you on where each device goes and which access system suits you. It's free.
How often do you come back?
Once you're live, we come back at least every three months to review every feature with you and see what can be improved.
Can I open 24 hours without staff?
Yes, if you want to. Members sign up, pay and get in on their own, and you control everything from the panel. We plan it with you based on your premises and hours.
Which access system suits me?
It depends on your gym. We can install QR, face recognition, RFID wristbands or cards, turnstiles or a 3D people counter, or combine them. At the visit we recommend what makes sense for you.
Can I ask for changes to the app?
Yes. We adapt to how you work: we change what doesn't fit and build what you're missing for your gym.
Do members need to download anything from an app store?
No. It's an installable web app: members open your gym's link on their phone and add it to their home screen in a couple of taps.
How do my members pay?
Online by card or Bizum from the app, through the Redsys banking gateway, or at the desk in cash or by card terminal.
What happens if the connection drops?

For security, no entry is validated offline and the screen asks the member to go to the front desk. With the Complete pack, a 4G backup and a UPS keep the door working if the fibre or power goes down.
Can I bring my current members?
Yes. We prepare the migration from your current software so you don't have to sign anyone up by hand.
How much does it cost?
It depends on what your gym needs. We start from the packs and, after the visit, give you a fixed, tailored price.
